`interface ISnapshotBackend`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Lwjgl2SnapshotBackend`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2snapshotbackend/), [`Lwjgl3SnapshotBackend`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3snapshotbackend/), [`VulkanSnapshotBackend`](/reference/vulkan/vulkansnapshotbackend/), [`IBorrowedTextureBackend`](/reference/testing/iborrowedtexturebackend/), [`IStateGuardBackend`](/reference/testing/istateguardbackend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [ISnapshotBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/ISnapshotBackend.java)

A hidden surface on which a backend is registered, that the testkit draws on and captures.

## Learn more

- [Give the testkit a surface](/build/testing-a-backend/#give-the-testkit-a-surface)
- [Testing your UIs](/use/learn/running/testing/)

| `void` | [create](#ISnapshotBackend-method-create)(int width, int height) <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> | Creates a hidden surface of that size in pixels and registers your backend on it, without audio. |
